description:
Leonard Wilson Keenan 

Our Business is you.. 

3 Bedroom 1 Bathroom semi Detached Family Home 
Separate Garden Room 
Potential for Renovation and Expansion 

Richard Todd and LWK Group are delighted to present 2 The Cottage, Cortlodge, to the property market.

This is a charming three-bedroom semi-detached cottage. Nestled in a peaceful setting and conveniently located close to town, this property offers the best of both worlds, providing countryside lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of nearby villages, amenities and transport links.
Set on a generous site of approximately 0.6 acres, the home is surrounded by beautifully maintained private grounds with a sunny south-westerly orientation, making it an ideal place to enjoy the scenic countryside views. 

The mature gardens are a particular feature of the property, boasting a large number of established trees and fruit trees which provide both beauty and seasonal produce. The property also benefits from a large garden room, private driveway with ample parking and wide side access providing vehicle access to the rear garden. There is also excellent potential to extend the property, subject to the necessary planning permission.

 The well-maintained accommodation is bright and well proportioned throughout, offering an ideal layout for modern family living. The bright entrance hall is spacious and welcoming, with wood flooring and storage space.  The bright open-plan kitchen and dining room features wood flooring, a fitted kitchen with an abundance of base and eye level storage, an integrated cooker and hob, and a large island with stone worktop, built-in storage and seating area. A feature stove adds to the warmth of the room, while French doors provide direct access to the rear garden. The living room also has wood flooring, overlooks the rear garden and is conveniently accessed from the kitchen/dining room. The property is perfect form family time and entertaining.

The main bedroom is a spacious double room with wood flooring, a feature fireplace with stove insert and built-in wardrobes, while enjoying views over the front garden. The second bedroom is also a double room with wood flooring and hanging and shelving units, overlooking the front garden.

The third bedroom is currently used as features wood flooring, hanging and shelving units and a Velux window, making this a versatile space that could comfortably serve as either a third bedroom or home office. The family bathroom is finished with a tiled floor and fully tiled walls and comprises a WC, wash hand basin and bath with bath screen, together with a window providing natural light.

The large garden room is an excellent additional space and features wood flooring and double-glazed windows, comprising a spacious main room and a separate home office. This versatile area offers excellent potential for a variety of uses, whether as a home office, entertainment  studio or additional living space.

Outside, the long rear garden is mainly laid in lawn and features a patio area, mature trees and established fruit trees. 

To the front, there is a large private garden with a tarmac driveway, lawn area and mature planted areas, together with a wide side entrance providing vehicle access to the rear garden.

Court­lough is a highly sought-after location, offering a tranquil rural lifestyle with easy access to the nearby villages of Balrothery and Skerries, as well as the M1 motorway, Ardgillan Castle and Demesne and Flynn Park, a popular outdoor activity centre located just minutes away. Balrothery is a charming village steeped in history, dating back to medieval times, and has retained much of its traditional character, with quaint streets, a strong sense of community and beautiful scenic countryside surroundings.

The location is particularly appealing for families, with a selection of primary and secondary schools within the surrounding area. Hedgestown National School is approximately 2.1km from the property, while Balrothery National School is approximately 2.4km away. For secondary education, Ardgillan Community College is approximately 3.7km from the property, with a number of further secondary schools available in the nearby Balbriggan and Skerries areas.

Court­lough is a highly sought-after location, offering a peaceful rural lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of both Balrothery and the popular seaside town of Skerries. Skerries is less than 10 minutes from No. 2 by car and is renowned for its beautiful coastline, sandy beaches, harbour and vibrant community. The town offers an excellent range of cafés, restaurants, shops and leisure facilities, while the surrounding coastline provides wonderful opportunities for walking, swimming, sailing and enjoying the outdoors. The nearby Ardgillan Castle and Demesne also provides extensive parkland, gardens and coastal views, while Flynn Park, a popular outdoor activity centre, is just minutes away.

For commuters, the property is well positioned for access to the M1 motorway, with Dublin Airport approximately 12 miles away. Public transport is also readily accessible, with bus services available from the surrounding Courtlough and Balrothery area. The Courtlough bus stop is approximately 850 metres away, with services including Route 101 towards Dublin and Drogheda, while the Balrothery area is also served by Route 191, providing further connections towards Dublin.

Balrothery itself is a charming village steeped in history, dating back to medieval times, and has retained much of its traditional character, with quaint streets, a strong sense of community and beautiful scenic countryside surroundings. The combination of its peaceful village atmosphere, excellent accessibility and proximity to both the coast and larger neighbouring towns makes Courtlough an increasingly desirable location for those looking to enjoy a more relaxed way of life without being removed from everyday conveniences.

Skerries, located less than 10 minutes from the property, offers an excellent choice of sporting and recreational facilities, with clubs catering for cricket, golf, sailing, rugby, GAA and tennis. The area is particularly attractive for those who enjoy an active outdoor lifestyle, with beaches, coastal walks, parks and countryside all close at hand.

In summary, No. 2 The Cottage offers a rare opportunity to enjoy a peaceful countryside lifestyle while benefiting from the convenience of nearby town and seaside amenities. With approximately 0.6 acres of mature private grounds, excellent parking and vehicle access, a spacious garden room, potential to extend subject to planning permission, nearby schools, easy access to Skerries and the coast, and good public transport connections, this charming home offers an exceptional combination of space, privacy, character and location. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this wonderful property has to offer.
